en.<strong>Activos sin modelo ni firmware r: Assets with no resolved model or firmware. If the sensor did not determine model and version, it cannot associate CVEs even if the asset is in its inventory. Check how many nodes have those fields empty: that number is the diagnosis.
en.<strong>Modo aprendizaje.</strong> Un se: Learning mode. A sensor in the baseline phase does not alert, by design.
en.<strong>Punto de captura distinto.</stro: Different capture point. If the other tool was connected to another SPAN, it sees different traffic. Compare each one's inventory, not the finding count.
en.<strong>Sondeo activo habilitado o no.</: Active probing enabled or not. OT platforms identify firmware in two ways: passively and by controlled active probing. If one has it on and the other does not, the first enumerates CVEs and the second does not, on exactly the same network.
en.<strong>Taxonomia distinta.</strong> Lo: Different taxonomy. What one tool calls a 'vulnerability' another reports as a hygiene alert, a configuration risk or an asset attribute. Compare finding by finding, not the totals.

en.Acceso de gestion solo desde el servidor: Management access only from the jump server or the management VLAN; console and auxiliary port protected.
en.Acceso remoto (VPN o servidor de salto): Remote access (VPN or jump server) with multi-factor authentication, logged sessions and third-party access with an expiry date.
en.Acceso remoto a la estacion solo por el: Remote access to the workstation only through the jump server, with strong authentication and logging; no remote desktop open to other zones.
en.Acceso remoto al equipo solo desde la es: Remote access to the device only from the authorized engineering workstation or jump server, with logging and no direct access from other networks.
en.Acceso remoto solo desde el servidor de: Remote access only from the jump server or the management network, with logging.
en.Acceso remoto, protocolos en texto claro: Remote access, cleartext protocols, file sharing or external DNS between zones widen what an attacker can reach from a compromised zone.
en.Accesos y cambios de configuracion regis: Accesses and configuration changes logged, on the device or in a central log, if the device allows it.
en.Accesos, cambios de configuracion, desca: Accesses, configuration changes, logic downloads and faults logged on the device or sent to a central log.
en.Aclarar por que una misma IP la anuncian: Clarify why several MAC addresses announce the same IP and fix the duplication or close the possible spoofing.
en.Acordar con el dueno del proceso en que: Agree with the process owner when writes usually happen (setpoint changes, downloads) and capture at those times.
en.Acordar con el dueno del proceso la dura: Agree with the process owner the duration of the new capture, so that it covers a complete operation cycle, shift changes and periodic maintenance.
en.Acordar con el proveedor una via de sopo: Agree an alternative support channel with the vendor before blocking access to a critical device.
en.Acotar las politicas que permiten trafic: Narrow the policies that allow traffic from the IT or Internet interfaces to the control zone: specific source, destination and service.
en.Acotar origen, destino y servicios a lo: Narrow the source, destination and services to what is observed and necessary.
en.Activar AAA con un servidor mal configur: Enabling AAA with a misconfigured or unreachable server can lock everyone out of the switch; on a plant switch, recovering it requires going on site with a console.
en.Activar BPDU guard con spanning-tree por: Enable BPDU guard with spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default or spanning-tree bpduguard enable on the port, and storm control with storm-control broadcast level (verify the syntax in the manufacturer's documentation for the installed version).
en.Activar BPDU guard en los puertos de acc: Enable BPDU guard on access ports with portfast, knowing it will shut down the port that receives a BPDU.
en.Activar BPDU guard por puerto (spanning-: Enable BPDU guard per port (spanning-tree bpduguard enable) or globally for portfast ports (spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default) (verify the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Activar DHCP snooping con ip dhcp snoopi: Enable DHCP snooping with ip dhcp snooping and ip dhcp snooping vlan, mark the ports toward the server with ip dhcp snooping trust, and ARP inspection with ip arp inspection vlan (verify the syntax in the manufacturer's documentation for the installed version).
en.Activar RA Guard en los puertos de acces: Enable RA Guard on access ports; if IPv6 is not used, disable it on the devices and block ICMPv6 type 134 on the segment.
en.Activar el control de tormentas en los p: Enable storm control on access ports to limit broadcast and unknown traffic.
Enable storm control on access ports and BPDU protection on edge ports, first in the lab and then in the agreed window.
en.Activar el modelo nuevo de AAA y declara: Enable the new AAA model and declare the servers with aaa new-model and tacacs server or radius server (verify the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Activar el registro (log) en la regla am: Enable logging on the broad rule and observe it for a full operating cycle, including start-ups, backups and periodic maintenance.
en.Activar el registro (log) en la regla de: Enable logging on the return rule and observe one operating cycle to see whether it is used.
en.Activar el registro (log) y, en la venta: Enable logging and, in the agreed window, block direct Internet outbound access from the OT zone.
en.Activar el registro de comandos y de acc: Enable command and access logging to the central server.
en.Activar el registro de conexiones en la: Enable connection logging on the rule before changing its action to block.
Enable connection logging on the rule before disabling it.
en.Activar el registro de todo el trafico e: Enable logging of all traffic on the broad policy and review the traffic log.
en.Activar el registro de trafico DNS hacia: Enable logging of DNS traffic to the Internet and review which devices use it.
en.Activar el registro de trafico en la pol: Enable traffic logging on the policy before switching it to deny.
Enable traffic logging on the return policy before disabling it.
en.Activar inspeccion sobre trafico de cont: Enabling inspection on real-time control traffic can add latency or block valid frames of industrial protocols through false positives.
en.Activar la proteccion contra anuncios fa: Enable protection against forged advertisements on the switch access ports, first in the lab and then in the agreed window.
en.Activar la proteccion en un puerto de pr: Enable the protection on a test port and confirm that the port goes into error state when it receives a BPDU, with the event logged.
en.Activar port-security (maximo de MAC por: Enable port-security (maximum MACs per access port, with shutdown or restrict action) and storm-control; locate the source port and check whether it is a virtualized device with many MACs.
en.Activar port-security con switchport por: Enable port-security with switchport port-security and its maximum number of addresses, and confirm with show port-security and show spanning-tree summary (verify the syntax in the manufacturer's documentation for the installed version).
en.Activar root guard en los puertos hacia: Enable root guard on the ports toward the access switches, so they cannot become root.
en.Activar spanning-tree guard root en los: Enable spanning-tree guard root on the ports toward the access layer (verify the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Activar storm control en los puertos de: Enable storm control on access ports with a threshold agreed with operations, and shrink the broadcast domain if needed.
en.Actividad de ingenieria sobre controlado: Engineering activity on controllers (download, start or stop)
en.Activo nuevo no aprobado en la red: New unapproved asset on the network

en.Actualizar el diagrama y la documentacio: Update the diagram and the network documentation.
en.Actualizar el gestor de licencias a la v: Update the license manager to the version the vendor validates, within the agreed window.
en.Actualizar el inventario con la direccio: Update the inventory with each device's address and VLAN.
en.Actualizar el servidor o su configuracio: Update the server or its configuration to offer TLS 1.2 or 1.3 with current suites, temporarily keeping the old one.
en.Actualizar la lista de origenes autoriza: Update the list of sources authorized to write to each controller.
en.Actualizar o reemplazar un sistema de co: Updating or replacing a control system without vendor validation can leave it inoperable; leaving it without controls keeps it exposed to known flaws.
en.Administracion con cuentas por persona y: Administration with per-person accounts and least privilege; service accounts without interactive logon.
en.Administracion por protocolos cifrados;: Administration over encrypted protocols; where that is not possible, only from an isolated management network.
en.Administracion remota solo desde el serv: Remote administration only from the jump server or the management network, with strong authentication and logged sessions.
en.Administracion remota solo por protocolo: Remote administration only over encrypted, authenticated protocols; no Telnet, unencrypted VNC or HTTP for administration.
en.Administracion, consultas a base de dato: Administration, database queries and historian replication encrypted (TLS, SSH, LDAPS); no FTP, Telnet or HTTP for administration.
en.Administradores con cuenta por persona,: Administrators with a per-person account, separate roles and multi-factor authentication.
en.Agregar al switch los controles de capa: Add to the switch the missing layer 2 controls (BPDU guard, storm control, port-security, DHCP snooping and ARP inspection) without cutting off equipment that works today.
en.Agregar la VLAN a la sesion de monitoreo: Add the VLAN to the existing monitor session with monitor session N source vlan X (verify the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Agregar la VLAN a una sesion SPAN (o RSP: Add the VLAN to a SPAN (or RSPAN/ERSPAN) session toward the sensor or capture it with a TAP; check the destination port load first.
en.Agregar la regla de cada acceso confirma: Add the rule for each confirmed access before blocking, limited to its window.
en.Agregar la regla de cada operacion confi: Add the rule for each confirmed operation before blocking.
en.Agregar la regla de cada renovacion conf: Add the rule for each confirmed renewal before blocking.
en.Agregar la regla de cada tarea confirmad: Add the rule for each confirmed task before blocking.
en.Agregar un sensor o un espejo sin plan p: Adding a sensor or a mirror without a plan can load a link or a control switch; not doing it leaves segments unmonitored.
en.Agrupar las alertas por firma, origen, d: Group the alerts by signature, source, destination and asset, and sort them by severity and asset criticality.
en.Aislar o apagar el equipo que barre sin: Isolating or shutting down the sweeping device without knowing its function can stop a legitimate engineering station or monitoring server.
en.Aislar o bloquear un equipo sin confirma: Isolating or blocking a host without confirming an incident can stop a process; silencing alerts without criteria hides real incidents.
en.Aislar o limpiar un equipo de control si: Isolating or cleaning a control device without confirming the cause can stop operation; not investigating it can let an infection go unnoticed.
en.Ajustar el espejo para copiar ambos sent: Adjust the mirror to copy both directions, or capture at a point both directions pass through.
en.Ajustar el espejo para copiar un solo se: Adjust the mirror to copy a single direction per port, or use a single capture point.
en.Ajustar el espejo para incluir las VLAN: Adjust the mirror to include the VLANs and ports of interest, testing it first in a lab.
en.Ajustar la deteccion (umbrales, listas d: Tune detection (thresholds, known-activity lists) leaving a record of the change and its owner, without silencing whole signatures.
en.Ajustar la fuente del SPAN para no dupli: Adjust the SPAN source so it does not duplicate.
en.Ajustar las versiones de protocolo y las: Adjust the protocol versions and cipher suites with group policies (GPO) or the service configuration, and test on a pilot host.
en.Ajustar load-interval a 30 segundos en l: Set load-interval to 30 seconds on the interface to see shorter peaks (check the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Al comprar o contratar un sistema nuevo: When buying or contracting a new system, is its security assessed (patch support, lifecycle, security features) before approving it?
en.Alertas de seguridad registradas por la: Security alerts recorded by the platform (per the imported file)
en.Algunos equipos pierden funciones (licen: Some devices lose functions (license, time, support) if they cannot reach their vendor: consult before cutting.
en.Ampliar la captura a un periodo mas larg: Extend the capture to a longer period that includes startups, shift changes and maintenance tasks.
en.Analisis a partir de una exportacion: so: Analysis from an export: only total bytes and packets per conduit are available; there are no per-minute series, broadcast, ARP or retransmission data, and the baseline has no per-minute percentiles.
en.Analizar una captura con duplicados como: Analyzing a capture with duplicates as if it were real distorts volumes and conversations; changing the mirror without a plan can affect the switch.
en.Anotar el conducto, el volumen aprobado: Record the conduit, the approved volume (p95 per minute) and the current one, and the approved and current periodicity class.
en.Anotar el conducto, la regla y el respon: Record the conduit, the rule and the owner in the zone and conduit diagram.
en.Anotar el origen, el equipo destino, el: Record the source, the destination device, the protocol, the operations seen and the time, and compare them with the change and maintenance logs.
en.Anotar el puerto destino, los descartes: Note the destination port, the discards and since when they accumulate (last counter clear).
en.Anotar en el informe que lo no visto en: Note in the report that what was not seen in the short window is not ruled out.
en.Anotar en el informe que los volumenes d: Note in the report that the volumes in the original capture may be inflated.
en.Anotar en el registro del informe que el: Note in the report log that the traffic seen is almost all cyclic and that identification is partial.
en.Anotar en el registro del informe que la: Note in the report log that the capture does not allow devices to be identified and that the inventory is partial.
Note in the report log that device identification is partial and how many devices were left unidentified.
en.Anotar en la matriz de comunicaciones el: Record in the communication matrix the allowed service, its purpose and its owner.
en.Anotar la IP, el valor aprobado y el val: Record the IP, the approved value and the current value of firmware, model or MAC, and the time since which it is seen.
en.Anotar la IP, la MAC, el fabricante, el: Record the IP, the MAC, the manufacturer, the inferred role and the zone of each new device, and since when it has been seen.
en.Anotar la cobertura de los sensores por: Note the sensor coverage per segment.
en.Anotar la hora del pico, la VLAN y el pu: Note the time of the peak, the VLAN and the capture point, and correlate them with the operations log and recent changes.
en.Anotar la interfaz, su rol (troncal, upl: Note the interface, its role (trunk, uplink or access), utilization, drops and CRC, and since when the counters have been accumulating.
en.Anotar la limitacion en el informe: la c: Note the limitation in the report: the capture shows no writes, but that does not prove none exist.
en.Anotar los conductos afectados, el porce: Note the affected conduits, the retransmission percentage and the period, and compare them with the capture point's loss.
en.Anotar los conductos aprobados que no se: Record the approved conduits that were not seen and the window and points of the current capture.
en.Anotar los dos puertos de la evidencia (: Note the two ports from the evidence (the blocked one and its peer) and the VLAN.
en.Anotar los extremos, el puerto, el proto: Record the endpoints, the port, the protocol, the destination zone and since when the conduit has been seen.
en.Anotar para cada conducto el instante de: Record for each conduit the instant of the gap or of the last packet and compare it with the operation and change logs.
en.Anotar que detecciones dependen del cont: Note which detections depend on packet content and are limited by the current capture.
en.Apagar el puerto con shutdown dentro de: Shut down the port with shutdown inside the interface, and use interface range for several (verify the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Apagar el puerto de un equipo que result: Shutting down the port of a device that turns out to be a legitimate bridge (a ring, a gateway or an unrecognized industrial switch) can cut a segment; it is identified first and action is taken in a window.
en.Apagar el puerto equivocado corta la com: Shutting down the wrong port cuts the communication of a field device; a port in down state may be a powered-off, occasional-use or standby device.
en.Apagar los puertos de acceso que no se u: Shut down the access ports that are not in use so nobody can connect an unauthorized device to the network.
en.Apagar los puertos que no se usan (shutd: Shut down the ports that are not used (shutdown) and move them to an unused VLAN; confirm with operations that none is a standby or occasional-use device.
en.Apagar o bloquear el servidor equivocado: Shutting down or blocking the wrong server leaves devices without an address when they renew their lease, and leaving a rogue server in place hands out foreign gateway and DNS: first confirm which one is legitimate, and block in a window.
en.Apagar un puerto o quitar un cable para: Shutting down a port or pulling a cable to stop a loop can isolate a segment or leave a ring without its backup link; the origin is located with the logs and the intervention is done in a window or, if there is an incident, with the process owner present.
en.Apagar un servicio sin cifrar antes de p: Turning off an unencrypted service before testing the replacement can leave control devices without management access; not renewing the credentials leaves a key already visible on the network valid.
en.Apartar lo que nadie justifica y revisar: Set aside what nobody justifies and check whether the device is misconfigured (gateway, DNS, time).
en.Aplicar cambios de red en el equipo solo: Apply network changes on the device only in a window and without restarting the controller if there is no agreed window.
en.Aplicar controles compensatorios: aislar: Apply compensating controls: isolate the device in its zone, limit who connects to it, and watch it with alerts.
en.Aplicar el bloqueo en la ventana acordad: Apply the block in the agreed window and watch the log for devices that relied on direct outbound access.
en.Aplicar el bloqueo solo dentro de la ven: Apply the block only within the window agreed with operations; outside it, only observe and record.
en.Aplicar el cambio de una VLAN a la vez y: Apply the change one VLAN at a time and wait for the tree to reconverge.
en.Aplicar el cambio en todos los miembros: Apply the change on all members in the same window and with a configuration backup.
en.Aplicar el cambio en ventana y con respa: Apply the change in a window and with a policy backup; verify the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version.
en.Aplicar el cambio por grupos pequenos, e: Apply the change in small groups, starting with non-critical devices, within the agreed window.
en.Aplicar el cambio solo dentro de la vent: Apply the change only within the window agreed with operations; outside it, only observe and log.
en.Aplicar el cambio solo en ventana y sin: Apply the change only in a window and without restarting the controller if there is no agreed window.
en.Aplicar el control de tormentas con un u: Apply storm control with a threshold based on measured normal traffic, on a test port before extending it.
en.Aplicar el corte en la ventana acordada,: Apply the cut in the agreed window, starting with the broadest rule and with logging before blocking.
en.Aplicar el maximo de direcciones y la ac: Apply the maximum number of addresses and the restrict action on a test port before extending it.
en.Aplicar el modo acceso y la opcion que d: Apply access mode and the option that disables trunk negotiation on a test port before extending it to the others.
en.Aplicar el parche o la mitigacion del av: Apply the patch or mitigation from the vendor advisory in the agreed window; meanwhile, restrict the conduits that reach that asset to the essential.
en.Aplicar el parche o la mitigacion del fa: Apply the vendor patch or mitigation; if that is not possible, isolate the asset and restrict its conduits to the bare minimum.
en.Aplicar el perfil primero en modo de sol: Apply the profile first in log-only mode and review the events.
en.Aplicar el reemplazo solo dentro de la v: Apply the replacement only within the window agreed with operations; outside it, only plan and record.
en.Aplicar en la ventana acordada y dejar r: Apply within the agreed window and keep a record of the change and of the VLAN added.
en.Aplicar en la ventana acordada, un puert: Apply in the agreed window, one port or trunk at a time, starting with the end that is not the management link, with the other end ready.
Apply within the agreed window, one port or trunk at a time, with both ends of the trunk at the same moment.
en.Aplicar en la ventana acordada, un switc: Apply in the agreed window, one switch and one control at a time, and record each change.
en.Aplicar la autenticacion con cadena de c: Apply key-chain authentication to a test group and confirm that the members still elect active and standby.
en.Aplicar la autenticacion fuerte (MD5 o c: Apply strong authentication (MD5 or key chain) where the protocol version allows it; in versions that only define clear text, migrate version or protect with filters.
en.Aplicar la desactivacion de IPv6 por dir: Apply the IPv6 disabling through group policy only after testing it on a non-critical device.
en.Aplicar la politica en la ventana acorda: Apply the policy in the agreed window, first allowing all the conduit traffic with logging.
en.Aplicar la restriccion de instalacion de: Apply the software installation restriction by group policy, tested first on a non-critical device.
en.Aplicar las correcciones con acceso por: Apply the corrections with console access, one switch at a time.
en.Aplicar las correcciones en la ventana a: Apply the fixes in the agreed window, with console access, one switch at a time.
en.Aplicar los cambios de VLAN o de ACL en: Apply the VLAN or ACL changes in a window and with console access.
en.Aplicar los cambios sin reiniciar el con: Apply the changes without restarting the controller in production without an agreed window.
en.Aplicar los cambios solo en ventana y si: Apply the changes only in a window and without restarting the controller in production without an agreed window.
Apply the changes only in a window and without restarting the controller if there is no agreed window.
Apply the changes only in a window and without restarting the device in production without an agreed window.
en.Aplicar los cambios solo en ventana, sin: Apply the changes only in a window, without restarting the controller in production without an agreed window.
en.Aplicar solo las actualizaciones validad: Apply only the updates validated by the application vendor and test them first.
en.Aplicar storm-control broadcast y multic: Apply storm-control broadcast and multicast on access ports at a level validated with operations (check the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Aplicar una denegacion que hoy no actua: Applying a denial that does not act today can cut a flow the process uses and nobody documented; allowing it without review opens a gap.
en.Aplicarlo solo en ventana, sin reiniciar: Apply it only in a window, without restarting the controller in production without an agreed window.
en.Aprobar solo lo que el proveedor del SCA: Approve only what the SCADA vendor has validated.
en.Aprobar una linea base nueva en otra car: Approve a new baseline in another folder once the change is explained.
Approve a new baseline in another folder once the conduit is decided.
Approve a new baseline in another folder once the inventory is reconciled.
Approve a new baseline in another folder once the difference is explained.
Approve a new baseline in another folder if the change is the new normal behavior.
en.Aproximacion voraz (cobertura de conjunt: Greedy approximation (set cover): it does not guarantee the exact minimum and only counts what talked during the capture window. It is not vendor sizing: compare the Mbps and the assets with the sensor datasheet. Details in sensores_puntos.csv and sensores_brechas.csv.
en.Arquitectura de red OT y ciberseguridad: OT network architecture and OT cybersecurity
en.Asignar direccion fija o reserva por MAC: Assign a fixed address or a MAC reservation, one at a time and within the agreed window.
en.Asignar estado y responsable a cada aler: Assign a status and an owner to each alert and record the reason for the resolution.
en.Asignar una VLAN sin uso con switchport: Assign an unused VLAN with switchport access vlan (verify the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Asignar una direccion sin revisar el inv: Assigning an address without checking the inventory can duplicate another control device's address and cut its communication.
en.Atribuir el origen. Si es una herramient: Attribute the source. If it is an authorized tool, document the window and assess the risk of active scanning on level 1.
en.Auditoria de inicios de sesion, cambios: Audit of logons, privilege changes and configuration changes, with enough space and delivery to a central log.
en.Aunque estas subfunciones no reinician e: Although these subfunctions do not restart the device, blocking function code 8 with a badly built filter can also cut reads.
en.Autenticacion centralizada (TACACS+ o RA: Centralized authentication (TACACS+ or RADIUS) with a per-person account; local account only for emergencies and kept under custody.
en.Autenticacion local del switch sin AAA c: Local switch authentication without central AAA (per the switch configuration)
en.Autenticar a los administradores del swi: Authenticate the switch administrators against a central TACACS+ or RADIUS server, leaving a local user only as emergency access.
en.Averiguar por que no obtuvieron direccio: Find out why they did not obtain an address: DHCP server down, misconfigured relay, wrong VLAN or an unconfigured device.
en.Avisar al dueno del proceso y a quien re: Notify the process owner and whoever reviews the logs before correcting the time.

Block Tor and VPNs by application or by list on the firewall, and close the VPN, tunnel and proxy ports toward the Internet that have no owner, in the agreed window.
en.Bloquear a un origen que resulta ser una: Blocking a source that turns out to be a legitimate maneuver or engineering session can stop an operation in progress; not investigating it can let a new or compromised device that already writes to the process go unnoticed.
en.Bloquear dominios sin conocer su uso pue: Blocking domains without knowing their use can cut updates, licenses, time synchronization or vendor remote support.
en.Bloquear el DNS cifrado sin revisar que: Blocking encrypted DNS without checking which devices use it can leave applications that ship with it configured without names.
en.Bloquear el codigo de funcion 8 con un f: Blocking function code 8 with a badly built filter can also cut reads; testing the restart command on a device in production can silence it.
en.Bloquear el puerto 853 hacia Internet o: Block port 853 to the Internet or route it to an internal resolver that logs the queries.
en.Bloquear el puerto TCP 853 hacia Interne: Block TCP port 853 to the Internet from the control zone, with logging before blocking.
en.Bloquear el tipo de mensaje de anuncio d: Block the router advertisement message type on the segment, except from the authorized router.
en.Bloquear en el firewall el puerto 853 (D: Block port 853 (DoT and DoQ) and the known DoH resolvers toward the Internet from the control zone on the firewall, with logging before blocking.
en.Bloquear en el firewall y en el DNS o pr: Block the domains and ports of the unauthorized tools on the firewall and on the DNS or proxy, in the agreed window, and remove the tool from the device.
en.Bloquear en la ventana acordada los serv: Block, in the agreed window, the services that nobody justifies.
en.Bloquear escrituras sin saber cuales son: Blocking writes without knowing which are legitimate can stop SCADA, the operator or maintenance from acting on the process.
en.Bloquear salidas a Internet sin identifi: Blocking Internet outbound traffic without identifying it can cut licenses, time synchronization, updates or support from a vendor the process depends on.
en.Bloquear un origen que si es legitimo (u: Blocking a source that is legitimate (a backup HMI or maintenance in progress) can leave the operator without control of the process; confirm with operations first and then act.
en.Bloquear un resolvedor externo sin revis: Blocking an external resolver without checking who uses it can leave an application or a browser that ships with it without name resolution; first the use is identified and the internal resolver is set, and the block is applied in a window.
en.Bloquear un servicio de gestion o de esc: Blocking a management or write service used by operations or an integrator can leave a zone without control or without maintenance.
en.Borrar entradas o cambiar el servidor DN: Deleting entries or changing a device's DNS server without knowing which application uses it can cut communication of a control system that was working.
en.Borrar los contadores del puerto destino: Clear the counters of the destination port and measure the discards during a period of normal traffic to see whether they keep growing.
en.Borrar y documentar las reglas que no tu: Delete and document the rules that had no impact, with date and owner.

en.Buscar el aumento brusco de activos nuev: Look for the sudden increase of new assets in the window and its origin by segment.
en.Buscar las comunicaciones de HSRP o VRRP: Look for HSRP or VRRP communications in the matrix and the devices that take part in each group.
en.Buscar las comunicaciones del activo hac: Look for the asset communications to the tool domains and review the related alerts.
Look for the asset's communications toward the channel's domains and ports and review the associated alerts.
en.Buscar los activos con funcion de servid: Look for assets acting as DHCP servers in the inventory and the alerts associated with that communication.
en.Buscar si el equipo anuncio una raiz mej: Check whether the device announced a better root than the current one and review the root change finding from the same capture.
en.CDP y LLDP anuncian modelo y version de: CDP and LLDP advertise model and firmware version in clear text. It is the main source from which a passive engine derives CVEs. It also lets an attacker with access to the segment pick an exploit without scanning.

en.Cada persona usa una cuenta propia (no c: Does each person use their own (not shared) account to sign in to HMIs, engineering workstations and network equipment?

en.Calibrar el control de tormentas con el: Calibrate storm control with the measured normal traffic: a low threshold drops legitimate broadcast from industrial protocols.
en.Cambiar SNMP v1/v2c por v3 con autentica: Change SNMP v1/v2c to v3 with authentication and encryption (check the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Cambiar a bloqueo la regla del camino di: Change the direct path rule to block only after validating the new path.
en.Cambiar el modo de un puerto que en real: Changing the mode of a port that is actually a legitimate trunk to another switch or to a device with several VLANs cuts those VLANs; the use of the port is confirmed before fixing it and the change is made in a window.
en.Cambiar el modo de un puerto vuelve a ne: Changing a port's mode restarts link negotiation: a trunk that forms by negotiation today can drop if the other end is left in dynamic mode, and a port that becomes a trunk with a device today can lose its VLANs.
en.Cambiar el periodo de sondeo o cortar a: Changing the polling period or cutting off a client without identifying it can leave the operator without process data; a saturated network or controller can degrade further with blind adjustments.
en.Cambiar la IP del equipo equivocado, o a: Changing the IP of the wrong device, or enabling layer 2 protections without testing them, can leave a controller or its redundant partner without communication.
en.Cambiar la VLAN de un puerto o la nativa: Changing the VLAN of a port or the native VLAN of a trunk cuts communication until both ends match; a poorly coordinated VLAN change can stop operations.
en.Cambiar la autenticacion de un grupo de: Changing the authentication of a redundancy group on only one router makes the others ignore it and can cause two active routers or none; the change is coordinated on all members and made in a window.
en.Cambiar la configuracion DNS de los equi: Change the DNS settings of the devices (fixed or via DHCP) so that they use that resolver.
en.Cambiar la configuracion de proxy de un: Changing the proxy setting of a device that does need it to update or license can leave it without outbound access; leaving the lookup open allows traffic to be diverted.
en.Cambiar la politica de seguridad de un s: Changing the security policy of an OPC UA server disconnects the clients that only use None or that lack the trusted certificate; the process may lose data or write access.
en.Cambiar la red o la configuracion de un: Changing the network or a device's configuration to reduce retransmissions can interrupt control; measure first, and make changes in a window.
en.Cambiar la velocidad, agregar enlaces o: Changing the speed, adding links or moving VLANs on a trunk can interrupt everything that passes through it; do it in a window and with an alternate path.
en.Cambiar las credenciales que hayan viaja: Change the credentials that have traveled unencrypted and the default SNMP communities.
en.Cambiar las credenciales que viajaron en: Change the credentials that traveled in clear, once access has been migrated.
en.Cambiar las fuentes del SPAN no afecta e: Changing the SPAN sources does not affect the devices traffic, but a badly chosen destination can leave a field device without service; the change is done in a maintenance window.
en.Cambiar las reglas que dejan pasar trafi: Change the rules that let traffic through without inspection (trust, bypass) to rules that allow with inspection and logging, when the device supports it.
en.Cambiar primero a permitir con inspeccio: First change to allow with inspection in detection-only mode or with logging, without blocking.
en.Cambiar prioridades del arbol o apagar p: Changing spanning tree priorities or shutting down ports without a plan can isolate a segment or create a loop that saturates the control network; corrections are made one switch at a time and in a window.
en.Cambiar todos los miembros del grupo jun: Change all members of the group together: with different keys each router believes it is the only active one.
en.Cambiar un equipo o la red para bajar el: Changing a device or the network to lower the traffic without understanding the cause can affect control; first compare with the operation during the period.
en.Cambiar una credencial sin coordinarla p: Changing a credential without coordination can leave management tools and automatic backups without access to the switch; without remote access you have to go on site.
en.Cambio de firmware, modelo o MAC respect: Firmware, model or MAC change with respect to the approved baseline
en.Cambio del puente raiz de STP durante la: STP root bridge change during the capture
en.Canal anonimizador o tunel hacia Interne: Anonymizing channel or tunnel to the Internet (Tor, VPN or proxy)
en.Captura ilegible o sin paquetes: Unreadable capture or capture without packets
en.Capturar durante un arranque de equipo o: Capture during a device start-up or an engineering session, or enable active polling (Smart Polling or equivalent) on the sensor.
en.Capturar durante un arranque, una descar: Capture during a startup, an authorized program download or a maintenance task agreed with the process owner.
en.Capturar durante un periodo suficiente p: Capture for a long enough period to see periodic and sporadic traffic, because a short window can miss communications that happen rarely.
en.Capturar tambien en el nivel de supervis: Also capture at the supervision or engineering level, where there is more traffic that identifies devices.
en.Capturas de distinta duracion o en disti: Captures of different length or at a different moment of the process give different volumes without a failure.
en.Cargar los certificados de confianza y p: Load the trusted certificates and test with a test client.

en.Cerrar el camino directo y actualizar el: Close the direct path and update the zone and conduit diagram.
en.Cerrar el puerto o actualizar el gestor: Closing the port or updating the license manager without consulting the vendor can keep a licensed engineering or control application from starting.
en.Cerrar la transferencia sin conocer los: Closing the transfer without knowing the secondary servers can break replication between DNS servers and leave zones out of date.
en.Cerrar un camino que usa un integrador,: Closing a path used by an integrator, a historian or legitimate remote access can leave the process without support or without data.
en.Cerrar un conducto que si usa el proceso: Closing a conduit that the process does use can cut a control function; first confirm its reason with operations and close it in a window.
en.Ciberseguridad OT y TI, con el dueno del: OT and IT cybersecurity, with the device owner and the vendor

en.Clasificar cada dominio: actualizacion,: Classify each domain: update, license, time, vendor telemetry or unknown.

en.Como se gestionan el acceso remoto y las: How are remote access and third-party sessions managed: approval, duration and logging?

en.Como se sanean o destruyen los medios y: How are media and equipment sanitized or destroyed when they leave service?
en.Compara esta corrida con la linea base q: Compares this run with the baseline the team reviewed and approved for the site. A deviation is a change with respect to that reference, not an incident or a non-conformity: it may be an authorized change or a capture failure. The review columns are left empty on purpose: the analyst who reviews each deviation fills them in.
en.Comparar con el inventario y con el dise: Compare with the inventory and the redundancy design (controller, firewall or server pairs in high availability).
en.Comparar con la lista de VLAN del switch: Compare with the switch's VLAN list.
en.Comparar con la lista de segmentos que v: Compare with the list of segments the sensor sees to decide where to capture.
en.Comparar con la operacion del periodo (a: Compare with the operation during the period (start-ups, shutdowns, process changes); if there is no explanation, check the equipment on the conduit. The thresholds are not calibrated: confirm against the site baseline.
en.Comparar con las comunicaciones del sens: Compare with the sensor communications to see whether there are writes in other periods.
Compare with the sensor communications, which do not depend on the length of this capture.
en.Comparar con los permisos de cambio y la: Compare with the change permits and maintenance windows together with the process owner.
en.Comparar el inventario resultante con la: Compare the resulting inventory with the process owner's asset list.
en.Comparar el programa y los parametros ac: Compare the current program and parameters with the approved backup copy.
en.Comparar la bitacora de trafico con la p: Compare the traffic log with the policy that decides the flow and review the policy order.
en.Comparar la hora del switch con la de un: Compare the switch time with that of a reference device.
en.Comparar la ventana de captura con la op: Compare the capture window with the operation during the period: start-ups, shutdowns, recipe or process changes.
en.Comparar las versiones con los avisos de: Compare the versions with the vendor's security advisories and record the affected assets in the inventory.
en.Comparar los eventos de conexion con la: Compare the connection events with the access control policy (Policies > Access Control) to see which rule decides the flow (check the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Comparar velocidad y duplex negociados e: Compare the negotiated speed and duplex at both ends of the link (check the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Completar el inventario con otras fuente: Complete the inventory with other sources when the capture has no packets that identify the vendor, model or version of the devices.
en.Completar el inventario cuando el trafic: Complete the inventory when the captured traffic is almost all cyclic I/O, which does not say which device is which.
en.Comprobar desde la estacion de gestion q: Check from the management station that SSH works and that Telnet and HTTP no longer respond.
en.Comprobar que cualquier excepcion acepta: Check that every accepted exception has an owner and a review date.
en.Comprobar que el acceso cifrado funciona: Check that encrypted access works from the authorized stations.
en.Comprobar que el orden de reglas sigue e: Check that the rule order follows the agreed design.
en.Comprobar que la lista de excepciones ac: Check that the list of accepted exceptions has an owner and a review date.
en.Comprobar que las excepciones creadas so: Check that the exceptions created are narrow and have a review date.
en.Comunicacion hacia Internet desde un seg: Communication to the Internet from a control segment breaks the expected segmentation and is a path for exfiltration and command and control.

en.Con MAC de enrutamiento la tabla de zona: With routing MACs the zones table counts the inventory rows (one per IP); the baseline and the conduits use each asset's zone.
en.Con SecurityPolicy None el canal no firm: With SecurityPolicy None the channel neither signs nor encrypts: anyone who can see the network can read and alter reads, writes and calls, and impersonate either end. It is worse if the same server accepts Write or Call.
en.Con datos de firewall cargados, estos co: With firewall data loaded, these zone-to-zone conduits do not cross any firewall: nothing on the observed path enforces the separation between the two zones.
en.Con el registro, listar los origenes, de: With the log, list the sources, destinations and services actually used.
en.Con la herramienta de captura del analis: With the analyst's capture tool, repeat the capture on the same segment and filter only ARP to see whether the pattern repeats.
en.Con la hora del switch sin sincronizar,: With the switch clock unsynchronized, its logs cannot be correlated with those of other devices and cannot be used to reconstruct an incident.
en.Con la prioridad de fabrica, cualquier s: With the factory priority, any new switch with a lower MAC address or a lower priority takes over the tree root and changes the paths of all the VLAN traffic.
en.Con los paquetes cortados, el disector n: With the packets cut short, the dissector cannot read banners, firmware versions or protocol content. A passive CVE engine is left without the evidence it needs and raises no findings. This is a frequent cause of 'the tool sees nothing'.
en.Con tsa_sd en el perfil incluye las medi: With tsa_sd in the profile it includes the measures of section III of TSA directive SD 1580/82-2022-01E, with an own mapping to SP 800-53 not reviewed by the owner; a correspondence is not equivalence or proof of compliance; the client's implementation plan (CIP) is checked by hand and is SSI.
en.Con usuarios locales en cada switch no h: With local users on each switch there is no central deprovisioning or unified record of who administers the device: the account of someone who leaves stays active until it is deleted on each one.

en.Concluir que la red es plana por un arte: Concluding that the network is flat because of a capture artifact leads to an unnecessary segmentation plan; segmenting without a plan can cut control communications.
en.Concluir que la red tiene poco trafico p: Concluding that the network has little traffic because of a badly chosen capture point gives an incomplete inventory and matrix; changing the mirror without a plan can affect the switch.
en.Concluir que no hay comandos de control: Concluding that there are no control commands because the capture did not see them can give false comfort; widening the capture with a badly set up mirror port can affect the switch.
en.Concluir que no hay otras comunicaciones: Concluding that there are no other communications from a short capture gives an incomplete matrix; a long capture without a plan can fill the disk or load the link.
en.Concluir que un equipo no responde por u: Concluding that a device does not respond because of a one-direction capture leads to false diagnoses; changing the mirror without a plan can affect the switch.

en.Configurar el servidor de salto con cuen: Configure the jump server with individual accounts, multi-factor authentication and session logging.
en.Configurar el servidor y el metodo de au: Configure the server and the authentication method with local fallback, without closing the current session.

en.Configurar o corregir ntp server y, si s: Configure or fix ntp server and, if used, authentication with ntp authenticate and ntp trusted-key (verify the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).

en.Confirmar BPDU guard y control de tormen: Confirm BPDU guard and storm control on the access ports and record the cause.
en.Confirmar con ciberseguridad y TI el ser: Confirm with cybersecurity and IT the available authentication server and that it is reachable from the switch management network.
en.Confirmar con el aviso del fabricante qu: Confirm with the vendor advisory that the model and version of the asset are the affected ones and review its remediation; apply the patch or mitigation in the window agreed with operations and, in the meantime, restrict the conduits that reach the asset.
en.Confirmar con el cliente si corresponde: Confirm with the client whether it is an authorized tool and in which window it ran.
en.Confirmar con el cliente si hay otro pun: Confirm with the client whether there is another control point not loaded; if there is none, consider a firewall or a filtering rule that enforces the conduit between those zones.
en.Confirmar con el dueno de la red y retir: Confirm with the network owner and remove unused routes; ARP entries age out, so a rarely used route may have no ARP entry at the time of capture.
en.Confirmar con el dueno del proceso cuale: Confirm with the process owner which are powered-off, standby or occasional-use devices, to leave them out.
en.Confirmar con el dueno del proceso la di: Confirm with the process owner the address each device should have according to the inventory.
en.Confirmar con el dueno del proceso las i: Confirm with the process owner the integrations that use the credential before rotating it.

en.Confirmar con el dueno del proceso que d: Confirm with the process owner which broadcast is a normal part of the industrial protocol and which is not.

en.El I/O ciclico lleva solo valores de pro: Cyclic I/O carries only process values: no model, no version, no commands. A passive sensor uses it to build the communications map and the baseline, but not to enumerate vulnerabilities. It is the most likely technical reason why the OT platform shows the assets but no associated CVEs.

en.El ServerHello fija lo que se usa de ver: The ServerHello fixes what is actually used. SSL 3.0, TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 are obsolete, and NULL, EXPORT, anonymous, RC4, DES and 3DES suites give no real protection: the traffic can be decrypted or tampered with. If the server is an OT device it can rarely be patched, so the risk persists.
en.El acceso remoto (personal propio, integ: Does remote access (own staff, integrators, vendors) go through a controlled point, with strong authentication and session logging?
en.El cruce de texto contra avisos locales: A text match against local advisories does not prove the device is exploitable: a similarly named model or a misread version can produce a false row, and the absence of rows does not prove there are no flaws.
en.El cruce es por texto: antes de cualquie: The match is by text: before any change, confirm the device's actual model and version on site; updating a controller's firmware without testing can stop the process or leave the device unusable.

en.El diagnostico Modbus (consulta de eco,: Modbus diagnostics (echo query, counters, diagnostic register) do not change the device state, but only the engineering or maintenance station should use them.
en.El direccionamiento dinamico en nivel 1-: Dynamic addressing at level 1-2 complicates the inventory, breaks IP-based firewall rules and hinders traceability.
en.El escaneo activo en redes OT puede tumb: Active scanning on OT networks can knock over field devices that do not tolerate unexpected traffic. If it is the client's scanner, it also explains why that tool produces findings that a passive sensor does not.

The assignment of findings to domains, the questions and their mappings to NIST CSF 2.0 and IEC 62443 are unreviewed. en.Identificar los equipos que anuncian y r: Identify the devices that announce and receive RIP, the version and the routes they announce, using the capture log.
en.Identificar los equipos que buscan WPAD: Identify the devices that look up WPAD and the DNS server that answers, using the capture log.
en.Identificar los equipos que usan DNS cif: Identify the devices that use encrypted DNS (TCP port 853) and the destinations, using the capture log.
en.Identificar los protocolos activos (reso: Identify the active protocols (broadcast name resolution and service discovery) and the devices that use them, using the capture log.

en.Identificar los servidores que negocian: Identify the servers that negotiate obsolete TLS or weak suites and who administers them.
en.Identificar los servidores y los cliente: Identify the DHCP servers and clients in the segment and the range they hand out, using the capture log.
en.Identificar origen y destino de las peti: Identify the source and destination of the FC8 requests and whether they were a test, maintenance or unauthorized activity.
en.Identificar origen, destino y comando (C: Identify the source, destination and command (Cold Restart, Warm Restart or Stop Application) of each request.
en.Identificar origen, destino y subfuncion: Identify the source, destination and subfunctions of the FC8 requests, using the capture log.

en.Inventario de fuentes de registro segun: Inventory of log sources from the observed conduits: a conduit to a logging port or application (table in data/fuentes_log.json) counts as sending; the source is the sender and the destination is the collector, and replies do not count. 'No sending observed: verify' is a device that by its type usually sends logs and was not seen doing so; absence in the capture does not prove it does not send (capture window, SPAN coverage, sending through another interface). To confirm it, use the expected-services questions (esperados_no_observados.csv and preguntas_cliente.csv). The encryption column only reports whether the protocol is in clear text; it is not a finding. The tool does not read the devices' logging configuration and does not conclude compliance.
en.Investigar las alertas de mayor severida: Investigate the highest-severity alerts with the operations team, rule out false positives and tune signatures and segmentation according to what is confirmed.
en.LLMNR, NBT-NS y mDNS permiten envenenami: LLMNR, NBT-NS and mDNS allow name resolution poisoning (Responder and similar tools) to capture NTLM hashes and spoof services. An IT-style passive scanner usually reports this as a vulnerability; an OT platform classifies it as hygiene and may raise no alert.
en.La DMZ es una propuesta: no existe en el: The DMZ is a proposal: it does not exist in the analysis.
en.La VLAN 1 viaja sin etiqueta por los tru: VLAN 1 travels untagged over the trunks and carries switch control traffic (CDP, STP, VTP): using it for devices or as native VLAN makes VLAN hopping easier and mixes management with data.
en.La alcanzabilidad se calcula con comunic: Reachability is computed from observed communications: it does not prove that each hop is exploitable.
en.La captura no contiene ningun paquete qu: The capture contains no packet that reveals device identity
en.La captura no se analizo: no aporta equi: The capture was not analyzed: it contributes no devices, flows or findings. No conclusion in the report includes it, and the absence of findings on it does not mean the network is clean. A half-cut file is usually a partial copy or an interrupted capture.
en.La captura refleja operacion en estado e: The capture reflects steady-state operation. It does not allow concluding that no writes exist: only that none occurred in this window.
en.La cobertura es la de las exportaciones: Coverage is that of the imported exports: a segment with no conduits may have no sensor or may simply have had no traffic in the period. A conduit seen by several sources counts once, with the highest volume per date among them.
en.La cobertura indica que requisitos puede: Coverage shows which requirements can be related to traffic evidence; it is not a compliance assessment. Requirement text: official source in English.
en.La fecha limite del catalogo KEV la fija: The KEV catalog due date is set by CISA for US federal agencies (BOD 22-01): use it only as an urgency reference, not as an obligation of the client.
en.La gestion por HTTP o Telnet envia crede: Management over HTTP or Telnet sends credentials and commands in clear text: anyone observing the management network can capture and reuse them.

en.La matriz junta los requisitos ISA/IEC 6: The matrix joins the ISA/IEC 62443 baseline requirements by zone and conduit (SL-T) with the controls of the chosen NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 OT baseline (Appendix F.3, Table 22, on NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5). The status (as-is) comes only from the evidence of this run; the validation columns are filled in by the analyst from interview, document, on-site observation or technical evidence. A NIST baseline not declared in the profile is a proposal of the tool that the client sets. It includes one row per requirement of ISA/IEC 62443-2-1:2024 (the owner's own catalog) with the aggregated status of the 3-3 SRs it cites; a correspondence is not an equivalence or proof of compliance. This is technical evidence, not a compliance determination. Details in matriz_controles.csv.

en.Las MAC de enrutamiento (una MAC con muc: Routing MACs (a MAC with many IPs or public IPs) do not identify a device: one row per IP is shown and the router MAC goes in hop_mac.
en.Las alertas de seguridad se revisan, con: Are security alerts reviewed, with an assigned owner and a defined response time?
en.Las alertas de un sensor son evidencia d: A sensor's alerts are direct evidence of potentially adverse activity on specific conduits; those without observed traffic point to visibility gaps.
en.Las contrasenas tipo 7 se revierten con: Type 7 passwords are reversed with public tools and plain-text ones or the enable password are read from the configuration: a backup or a capture of the configuration exposes them.
en.Las decisiones de aceptar un riesgo (por: Are decisions to accept a risk (for example, not patching or not segmenting) documented and approved by the right person?
en.Las etiquetas son marcas para la revisio: Labels are review marks, not judgements: they show where to look first when deciding what to allow. The inventory comes from the traffic observed in the capture window or the export.
en.Las fallas continuas indican un servidor: Continuous failures indicate a DNS server that is misconfigured, unreachable or rejecting clients; devices may lose resolution and retry endlessly.
en.Las referencias a IEC 62443 son orientat: References to IEC 62443 are indicative. The target security level (SL) of each zone is defined with the IEC 62443-3-2 risk assessment, which this tool does not perform.
en.Las referencias a NERC CIP son orientati: References to NERC CIP are indicative and are not a compliance determination. The applicability of each requirement depends on the impact categorization of the BES Cyber Systems (CIP-002) and on the current version of the standard, neither of which can be inferred from traffic or from an inventory.
en.Las reglas de firewall entre zonas se re: Are the firewall rules between zones reviewed periodically, and are unused rules removed?
en.Las reglas sombreadas nunca se aplican y: Shadowed rules are never applied and unused rules widen the surface and the review load without adding control.
en.Las retransmisiones TCP indican paquetes: TCP retransmissions indicate lost or delayed packets between the endpoints: a saturated or erroring link, a slow device or a mirror that drops packets (it can be a capture artifact). On a control conduit they increase loop latency and can cut the session.
en.Las subcategorias citadas son de NIST CS: The subcategories cited are from NIST CSF 2.0. They are indicative: a passive analysis provides related technical evidence, not a CSF profile or a compliance assessment. The function is the prefix of the identifier (GV, ID, PR, DE, RS, RC); Govern (GV) has no evidence observable in traffic.
en.Las subfunciones 1 (Restart Communicatio: Subfunctions 1 (Restart Communications) and 4 (Force Listen Only Mode) leave the slave unresponsive or restarting its communications: a single message can take the device out of service. Modbus does not authenticate the source.
en.Las zonas declaradas vienen del perfil d: Declared zones come from the project profile; the others are inferred by the tool (firewall, platform, subnet or Purdue level) and must be confirmed with the client. The partitioning method is that of IEC 62443-3-2, used as a reference: this is technical evidence for that exercise, not a determination of compliance.

en.Limitar con reglas el trafico de descubr: Use rules to limit discovery traffic between zones, with logging before blocking.
en.Limitar con reglas que equipos pueden in: Use rules to limit which devices can start connections to many destinations in the control zone, with logging before blocking.
en.Limitar con reglas que solo las estacion: Use rules so that only authorized engineering stations speak the programming protocol with the controllers.
en.Limitar direcciones por puerto con una a: Limiting addresses per port with a shutdown action can leave a legitimate device with many MACs without communication (for example a server with virtual machines); the limit is calculated from the inventory and the change is made in a window.
en.Limitar donde pueden conectarse las esta: Limit where stations with discovery tools can connect, after testing in a lab or on a non-critical device.
en.Limitar el acceso de gestion a estacione: Limit management access to authorized stations and disable the unencrypted service in the agreed window.
en.Limitar el acceso de gestion por lista d: Limit management access by access list to the authorized stations.
en.Limitar el descubrimiento a la red de ge: Limit discovery to the management network and disable it on ports toward field devices that do not need it.
en.Limitar el puerto 1947 a los servidores: Limit port 1947 to the license servers and the clients that use it, with logging before blocking.
en.Limitar el servicio de licenciamiento HA: Limit the HASP licensing service to the devices that need it and keep it updated, instead of announcing it by broadcast across the whole network.
en.Limitar en cada servidor DNS la transfer: On each DNS server, limit zone transfers to the list of authorized secondaries.
en.Limitar la transferencia de zona DNS a l: Limit DNS zone transfers to the authorized secondary servers, because they hand over the full list of names and addresses on the network.
en.Limitar las VLAN permitidas en los tronc: Limit the allowed VLANs on the trunks and record the change.
en.Limitar las VLAN permitidas en los trunk: Limit the allowed VLANs on the trunks and keep a record of the change.
en.Limitar las lineas vty a SSH con transpo: Limit the vty lines to SSH with transport input ssh and apply the list with access-class (verify the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Limitar las transferencias de zona a los: Limit zone transfers to the authorized secondary servers and review the source of these queries.
en.Limitar los origenes que pueden hablar D: Limit the sources that can speak DNP3 (port 20000) to the outstation to the identified masters.
en.Limitar los protocolos de descubrimiento: Limit the neighbor discovery protocols on access ports to field devices (verify the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Limitar los servicios necesarios a orige: Limit the needed services to specific sources and destinations (allow lists) and, if applicable, to schedules.
en.Limitar o segmentar la difusion sin cono: Limiting or segmenting broadcast without knowing who needs it can cut discovery or control protocols that depend on it.
en.Limitar por origen, destino y servicio q: Use source, destination and service to limit who can write to each controller, with logging before blocking.
en.Limitar que origenes pueden hablar Modbu: Limit which sources can speak Modbus to the device (only the identified master).
en.Limitar quien puede iniciar sesion en la: Limit who can log on to the engineering stations with security groups and group policies (GPO).
en.Limitar quien puede iniciar sesion remot: Limit who can start a remote session on the control hosts using security groups and group policies (GPO).

en.Linea base construida con ISA/IEC 62443-: Baseline built with ISA/IEC 62443-3-3:2013 and 4-2:2018 (current editions before 2020), 3-2:2020 and technical report TR 2-2:2025. The target (to-be) is what the requirement catalog demands at the SL-T of each zone and conduit; the state (as-is) comes only from the evidence of this run. The bound per FR is a maximum according to the evidence, not a measured achieved level: read it together with the requirements without evidence and those not assessable. SL-T values not declared in the profile are proposals by the tool that the client sets. This is technical evidence, not a compliance determination. The baseline by program elements (SPE, sub-SPE and requirements of ISA/IEC 62443-2-1:2024) is in linea_base_2_1.csv, with the standard's identifiers, own titles and the published mappings to 3-3, 4-2 and 2-4; a mapping is neither an equivalence nor proof of compliance. The same SR can count in several SPEs: SPE totals do not add up.

en.Lista de verificacion propia por tipo de: Own checklist by equipment type, with points written in our own words and aligned to ISA/IEC 62443-4-2 (CR and EDR/HDR/NDR) and 3-3 (SR); the mappings are unreviewed. The type of each asset is inferred from its role (captures) or from the type the platform gives. 'Review: evidence against' means the run already shows a finding or a service that contradicts the point; 'Verify on site' means the run has no evidence and does not indicate the point is fine. The tool does not read device configuration and does not conclude compliance or a hardened device. The checklist for the visit is in hardening_baseline.csv.

en.Llenar la tabla de direcciones MAC hace: Filling the MAC address table makes the switch forward the traffic it does not know out of all its ports: whoever floods can see the control traffic of other devices. A switch with a full table also loses performance and can drop legitimate traffic.
en.Localizar el enlace redundante sin STP o: Locate the redundant link without STP or the cable placed by mistake, enable storm-control on access ports and BPDU Guard on edge ports, and review the routes that are advertised to each other.
en.Localizar el equipo por su MAC y su IP e: Locate the device by its MAC and IP in the inventory and confirm with the process owner whether it is a switch, a software bridge or a device with two interfaces.
en.Localizar el puerto de switch del servid: Locate the switch port of the unrecognized server by its MAC and check who connected it and since when.
en.Localizar el puerto que origina los camb: Locate the port that originates the changes (the one in the evidence), review the link and the connected devices and fix it with operations in a window; confirm BPDU guard and storm-control on the access ports.
en.Localizar en la captura los paquetes ARP: Locate in the capture the ARP packets with the same IP and a different MAC and note the times, as a log of the evidence.
en.Localizar por MAC al equipo que anuncia: Locate the advertising device by MAC and check in the inventory whether it is a router or an end device; keep the record.
en.Localizar por MAC el puerto de cada orig: Locate by MAC the port of each source of DTP or double-tagged frames and check whether it is a link between switches; keep the record.
en.Lograr que el puerto destino del SPAN no: Make the SPAN destination port stop dropping packets, so the capture that reaches the sensor is complete.
en.Lograr que la captura vea los dos sentid: Make the capture see both directions of each conversation, so as not to conclude that traffic goes unanswered when it is a limitation of the capture point.
en.Los Tiers de NIST CSF 2.0 caracterizan e: The NIST CSF 2.0 Tiers characterize the rigor of governance and risk management practices; the tool does not measure them. The current tier is declared by the organization (NIST SP 1302) and the target is set by the profile. The NIST rows per function come from the CSF 2.0 informative references and are related evidence from the run, not a verdict; never a compliance determination.
en.Los archivos de CISA son una fuente exte: The CISA files are an external source the analyst downloaded: a CVE match does not prove the device is exploitable or has been attacked.
en.Los cambios de topologia repetidos y una: Repeated topology changes and a MAC jumping between ports are symptoms of a loop, of a link that goes down and up, or of a device with two connections; each change can flush the MAC table and briefly cut control traffic.
en.Los codigos 13 (Cold Restart), 14 (Warm: Codes 13 (Cold Restart), 14 (Warm Restart) and 18 (Stop Application) restart or stop the outstation application and take it out of service. Only the authorized master should send them, and almost never during normal operation.
en.Los conductos entre zonas agrupan los co: Zone-to-zone conduits group the observed conduits by pair of zones, following the IEC 62443-3-2 method as a reference. Gaps are marks to review, not judgments: they show where to look first. This is technical evidence for that exercise, not a compliance determination.
en.Los conductos esporadicos pueden no apar: Sporadic conduits may not appear in a short window without a failure.
en.Los contadores de BPDU son acumulados de: BPDU counters are cumulative since boot or the last clear: compare two readings before concluding the loop persists.
en.Los contadores son acumulados desde el a: Counters are cumulative since boot or the last clear: do not conclude from a single reading.
en.Los contadores y el numero de cambios so: The counters and the number of changes are cumulative since boot or the last clear: compare two readings before concluding that the problem continues.
en.Los contratos con integradores y proveed: Do contracts with integrators and vendors include cybersecurity requirements (access, patches, incident notification)?
en.Los controles citados son de NIST SP 800: The controls cited are from NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, the catalog on which NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 defines the OT guidance. They are indicative and do not amount to a compliance assessment.
en.Los descartes son acumulados desde el ar: Discards are cumulative since boot or the last clear: do not conclude from a single reading.

The inventory and communications exports do not distinguish reads from writes, so no conduit appears as critical because of writes: that distinction requires the analysis of the captures.

en.Los paquetes que permiten identificar un: The packets that allow a device to be identified are scarce and sporadic (announcements every 30-60 s, discovery responses, initial negotiations). A short capture window, or a sensor that started after the devices had already negotiated, misses them.

en.Los permisos se asignan por rol y se rev: Are permissions assigned by role and reviewed when someone changes position or leaves?

en.Si el hueco no tiene explicacion, revisa: If the gap has no explanation, check the controller load and the link, and repeat the capture in the same window.
en.Si el indicador es el dominio canario de: If the indicator is the Firefox canary domain, treat it only as a hint: confirm on the device whether the browser has DNS over HTTPS enabled.

en.Si es legitimo, agregarlo al inventario: If it is legitimate, add it to the inventory with owner, criticality and zone.
en.Si es legitimo: documentarlo y crear una: If it is legitimate: document it and create a specific rule, with specific source, destination and port.
en.Si es un equipo final o un puente de sof: If it is an end device or a software bridge, check its bridge configuration and turn off the tree protocol on the device if it is not needed.
en.Si es un equipo final, revisar si tiene: If it is an end device, check whether it has Internet connection sharing or a network bridge active that advertises unintentionally.
en.Si es un firmware nuevo no autorizado, r: If it is a new unauthorized firmware, check the device against the backup copy of the program and parameters.

en.Si es una aplicacion mal configurada, co: If it is a misconfigured application, fix the name or the server in the agreed window.
en.Si es una duplicidad de configuracion, c: If it is a configuration duplication, fix it in the agreed window and update the inventory.

en.Si esta justificado, limitarlo a los ext: If it is justified, limit it to the necessary endpoints and ports and document it in the communications matrix.
en.Si hay errores CRC, revisar cableado, co: If there are CRC errors, check the cabling, connectors, transceivers and duplex of the link.

en.Si la red es plana, definir con el dueno: If the network is flat, define the target segments with the process owner and the approved architecture.

en.Si no alcanza, usar un puerto destino de: If that is not enough, use a faster destination port or a TAP on the main link.
en.Si no es legitimo: localizar por que no: If it is not legitimate: find out why it is not blocked (a route that bypasses the firewall, a misplaced rule) and fix it, with prior logging.
en.Si no es posible, limitar el acceso por: If it is not possible, limit access by source and plan the replacement.

en.Si no esta autorizado, tratarlo con el p: If it is not authorized, handle it with the customer's incident procedure and review the source.
en.Si no esta justificado, bloquearlo en el: If it is not justified, block it in the firewall or in the switch access lists and record the rule.
en.Si no estaba autorizado, aislarlo en una: If it was not authorized, isolate it in a quarantine VLAN or disconnect it in the agreed window.
en.Si no estaba autorizado, limitar el cond: If it was not authorized, restrict the conduit in the firewall or switch so that only the approved orchestrators write to the device.
en.Si no hay autorizacion, tratarlo como in: If there is no authorization, treat it as an incident under the customer's procedure and compare the running program with the last approved backup.
en.Si no hay explicacion legitima, aislar e: If there is no legitimate explanation, isolate the port in the agreed window and treat it as an incident.
en.Si no hay explicacion operativa, tratarl: If there is no operational explanation, treat it as a failure or unexpected use and correct the source in a window.
en.Si no hay explicacion, abrir un incident: If there is no explanation, open an incident and review the source port of each MAC.
en.Si no hay explicacion, tratarlo como inc: If there is no explanation, treat it as an incident under the customer's procedure and decide with operations how to contain the device.
en.Si no hay impacto durante el periodo aco: If there is no impact during the agreed period, delete it; if there is, replace it with a rule narrowed to the exception.
en.Si no hay parche o no se puede aplicar:: If there is no patch or it cannot be applied: apply mitigations (segmentation, blocking the vulnerable service, allow list) with logging and document them.
en.Si no hay registro que lo respalde, trat: If there is no record to support it, treat it as an incident following the client's procedure and decide with operations how to contain the source.
en.Si no hay registro, verificar fisicament: If there is no record, physically verify the device (label, serial number, switch port).

en.Si se decide contener, bloquear con una: If containment is decided, block with a rule narrowed to the flow and with connection logging.
en.Si se decide contener, usar una politica: If containment is decided, use a policy narrowed to the flow and not to the whole host, with traffic logging.
en.Si se desactiva Telnet o HTTP antes de p: If Telnet or HTTP is disabled before SSH or HTTPS is tested, remote access to the switch is lost; recovering it requires going on site with a console cable, and the switch may serve field devices.
en.Si se usa inspeccion de aplicaciones ind: If industrial application inspection is used, first test the function code filter in detection mode.
If industrial application inspection is used, first test the function code filter in detection mode.

en.Si un cliente no puede migrar: aislarlo: If a client cannot migrate: isolate it in its zone and limit access to the server by source.
en.Si un equipo anuncia una prioridad mejor: If a device announces a better priority than the root bridge, it takes the root and traffic flows through its port: it can be intercepted or interrupted, and the reconvergence causes micro-outages. It also happens legitimately if the root switch fails or restarts.
en.Si un puerto quedo en err-disable por BP: If a port ended up in err-disable because of BPDU guard or storm control, treat it as evidence of a loop or a wrongly connected device before re-enabling it.
en.Sin BPDU guard un equipo o un cable cone: Without BPDU guard, a device or a cable connected to an access port can send BPDUs and change the spanning tree root or close a loop; without storm-control, a broadcast storm saturates the switch and the control equipment; without port-security, DHCP snooping or ARP inspection, a connected device can spoof a MAC, a DHCP server or the gateway.
en.Sin CDP, LLDP, banners, respuestas de de: No CDP, LLDP, banners, discovery responses or identity objects.
en.Sin autenticacion, o con una clave en te: Without authentication, or with a clear-text key visible on the network, any device can advertise maximum priority, become the gateway and divert or interrupt traffic between zones. HSRPv1 only defines clear text and VRRPv3 does not define authentication.

en.Sustituir las reglas que permiten cualqu: Replace the rules that allow any source to any destination with rules with a specific source, destination and service.
en.Sustituir las rutas aprendidas por rutas: Replace the learned routes with documented static routes or a protocol with authentication, in a lab test.
en.Sustituir los protocolos de gestion y au: Replace unencrypted management and authentication protocols with encrypted alternatives and renew the credentials that may have been exposed.

A name, a port, a protocol or an IP from the list is evidence that someone uses it or tries to, not proof of a session or that it is unauthorized.

en.Tratar como fallo una pareja redundante: Treating a redundant pair that switches MAC as a fault, or changing an IP without confirming the device, can break control redundancy.
en.Tratar como incidente toda escritura de: Treat every write from an unrecognized source as an incident, under the customer's procedure.

en.Ubicar el puerto de switch y la VLAN del: Locate the switch port and the VLAN of the device in order to find it physically.
en.Ubicar el puerto del equipo origen en la: Locate the source device's port in the address table and review who connects it.

en.Ubicar la MAC emisora con show mac addre: Locate the emitting MAC with show mac address-table address and the port with show interfaces (check the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
