en.Un Router Advertisement falso hace que l: A forged Router Advertisement makes IPv6-enabled devices (on by default in Windows) take the sender as gateway or DNS and send it their traffic, even if the control network is IPv4 only. Devices with connection sharing or misconfigured bridges also emit them.
en.Un SPAN configurado solo en RX (o solo e: A SPAN configured only on RX (or only on TX), or a single-fiber TAP, delivers half the conversation. The sensor cannot correlate request and response, and it loses precisely the responses, which carry banners, identity and firmware version. It directly explains why a tool at a different capture point does find results.
en.Un SPAN que copia el mismo paquete desde: A SPAN that copies the same packet from several ports inflates the counts and can trigger false retransmission positives in the sensor.
en.Un STP inestable provoca microcortes. En: An unstable STP causes micro-outages. In control, a micro-outage can lead to loss of communication with a controller and to a trip.
en.Un atacante con acceso a Internet o a la: An attacker with access to the Internet or the IT network could reach these critical assets by hopping through devices that already communicate with each other; each hop is an observed communication, not a proven vulnerability.
en.Un bucle multiplica las tramas hasta sat: A loop multiplies frames until it saturates links and the CPU of switches and field devices: it causes loss of communication with the controllers and micro-outages. The signs are consistent with a loop, they do not prove it: a capture from several points can see the same packet more than once.
en.Un cambio de VLAN o de nativa corta la c: A VLAN or native VLAN change cuts communication if the ends do not match: coordinate both sides beforehand.
en.Un cambio de hora altera las marcas de l: A time change alters the timestamps of the logs: note the previous and the new time.
en.Un cambio de raiz hace que el arbol reco: A root change makes the tree reconverge and can briefly cut traffic; it is done in a maintenance window with the process owner present.
en.Un conducto ausente puede ser solo un pu: An absent conduit can be just a different capture point or window: do not conclude from a single capture.
en.Un conducto de control que dejo de comun: A control conduit that stopped communicating can be a failure that affects the process; confirm with operations soon, without changing anything on the network until it is understood.
en.Un conducto de sondeo que era regular y: A polling conduit that was regular and is interrupted can be a failure of the link, the controller or the client, a restart or a maneuver; while the gap lasts the process is neither read nor commanded. It is evidence from a capture, not a diagnosis: the cut can also be in the capture itself.
en.Un conducto nuevo hacia el nivel 0-2 o d: A new conduit into level 0-2 or from the Internet is handled first.
en.Un conducto que une zonas separadas por: A conduit that joins zones two or more Purdue levels apart bypasses the intermediate zones that normally concentrate filtering.
en.Un equipo final que habla STP puede ser: An end device that speaks STP can be a software bridge or an attempt to become the root for interception or denial of service; it also indicates a port without BPDU Guard. A switch not recognized by manufacturer could appear here because of an inventory error.
en.Un equipo puede aparecer solo porque la: A device can appear only because this run captured a segment the previous one did not see.
en.Un escaneo activo puede saturar o bloque: An active scan can overload or lock up older controllers; blocking the scanner without identifying it can stop an authorized inventory or audit.
en.Un espejo mal configurado puede saturar: A badly configured mirror can saturate the destination port, load the switch CPU or, if pointed at the wrong port, leave a field device without service.
en.Un espejo por VLAN en un switch cargado: A per-VLAN mirror on a loaded switch can affect forwarding: measure the load before and after.
en.Un exceso de difusion degrada el desempe: Excess broadcast degrades the performance of field devices, which have limited network stacks, and can cause loss of communication.
en.Un filtro mal hecho sobre DNP3 puede cor: A badly built DNP3 filter can cut data polling; issuing a restart or stop command to an outstation in production can stop supervision or control.
en.Un firewall mal ubicado o una regla de b: A misplaced firewall or a wrong blocking rule cuts communication between zones and can stop the process.
en.Un firmware o un equipo cambiado en un c: A changed firmware or device on a controller can alter the behavior of the process; verify before accepting it as the new reference.
en.Un inventario basado en pocos paquetes p: An inventory based on few packets can miss silent devices; querying the devices with active scans to identify them can affect them.
en.Un inventario hecho solo con trafico cic: An inventory built only from cyclic traffic has no vendor or version; actively querying the controllers to obtain them can affect control.
en.Un inventario sin identidad de equipos p: An inventory without device identity can hide critical assets; querying the devices with active scans to obtain it can affect them.
en.Un origen que antes no enviaba operacion: A source that previously did not send control operations to that device now does. It may be an authorized change (a new HMI, maintenance) or unauthorized use of the control protocol.
en.Un origen que no hablaba con el controla: A source that did not talk to the controller and suddenly writes can be an authorized maneuver or engineering session, but also a new or compromised device or lateral movement: it is one of the signals an OT platform would alert on as new activity.
en.Un periodo de observacion corto puede no: A short observation period may miss seasonal traffic (maintenance, annual backup): extend it if in doubt.
en.Un puerto bloqueado que recibe BPDU del: A blocked port that receives BPDUs from the switch itself means two ports reach the same segment (a hub, an unmanaged switch or a server with bridged network cards): the physical loop exists and only STP contains it; if STP fails or an access port with portfast forwards it, the storm saturates the switch and cuts control traffic.
en.Un puerto de acceso que negocia troncal: An access port that negotiates a trunk (DTP visible) or sends double-tagged frames can reach VLANs it does not belong to and bypass segmentation. Double tagging is also normal in provider networks (802.1ad) and in some rings.
en.Un puerto de acceso sin uso y sin shutdo: An unused access port without shutdown allows an unauthorized device to be connected to the port VLAN.
en.Un puerto en trunk sin nonegotiate o en: A trunk port without nonegotiate or in dynamic mode negotiates with DTP: a connected device can request a trunk and receive the allowed VLANs (VLAN hopping) or bring the link down.
en.Un puerto que solo recibe lo que el swit: A port that only receives what the switch floods (broadcast, multicast and unknown traffic) does not see client-server conversations. That is exactly where explicit messaging, banners and the negotiations that identify model and firmware live. A sensor connected at this point builds a partial inventory and cannot enumerate vulnerabilities, whereas another one connected where unicast does pass succeeds. It is one of the most frequent explanations for two tools not matching.
en.Un sensor pasivo deriva fabricante, mode: A passive sensor derives manufacturer, model and firmware from these packets. Without them it cannot match against its CVE database, and so it reports zero vulnerabilities even though the devices are vulnerable. The absence of findings here is absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.
en.Un servidor DHCP que no es el del client: A DHCP server that is not the client's (or a second misconfigured server) hands devices its own gateway and DNS: it is a way to intercept control traffic and can leave devices without a valid address. Two servers can also be a legitimate backup pair; this must be confirmed with the client.
en.Un sistema sin soporte no recibe parches: A system without support receives no vendor patches. The date and source come from the end-of-support table; the obsolescence report lists each asset.
An unsupported system receives no patches. It is exactly the kind of finding a passive CVE engine raises as soon as it manages to read the version.
en.Un sondeo normalmente es regular. La irr: A poll is normally regular. Irregularity can come from network jitter or saturation, an overloaded controller or an unusual client (a manual tool, a scan) that is not the expected HMI or SCADA.
en.Una VLAN con equipos que ninguna sesion: A VLAN with devices that no SPAN session on the switch mirrors does not reach the sensor through that switch: its communications do not appear in the analysis or in monitoring.
en.Una VPN o un tunel hacia Internet puede: A VPN or a tunnel toward the Internet can be the access a vendor uses to support a critical device; closing it abruptly can leave the operator without assistance, so first the use is identified and an alternative path is agreed, and the block is applied in a window.
en.Una alerta es evidencia tecnica de la pl: An alert is technical evidence from the platform; by itself it does not confirm an incident.
en.Una caja por zona y, entre cajas, los co: One box per zone and, between boxes, the zone-to-zone conduits C-xx of the table: how many services they carry and, in another style, those with gaps flagged for review.
en.Una caja por zona, de la empresa (arriba: One box per zone, from the enterprise (top) to control (bottom), with the DMZ in between. Solid line: communication to allow; dashed: goes through the DMZ in two legs. What is blocked or reviewed is not drawn.
en.Una caja por {agrupacion} y, entre cajas: One box per {agrupacion} and, between boxes, the conduits that cross them: how many there are, which services they carry and how many carry writes. The conduits between boxes are the natural candidates for control {cruce}.
en.Una captura mas larga o en otro punto pu: A longer capture or one at another point can show conduits that already existed: confirm before concluding.
en.Una descarga o un cambio de modo no auto: An unauthorized download or mode change can alter or stop the process; blocking engineering without a plan can prevent legitimate maintenance.
en.Una direccion APIPA significa que el equ: An APIPA address means the device did not obtain an IP through DHCP. On the plant floor it usually indicates a misconfigured device, a DHCP server that is down or a device connected where it should not be.
en.Una interfaz cerca de su capacidad o que: An interface near its capacity or dropping packets delays or loses the control traffic passing through it; on a trunk it affects every VLAN that uses it. CRC errors point to cabling, connectors or duplex.
en.Una misma direccion IP muestra otro firm: The same IP address shows a different firmware, model or MAC than in the baseline. It may be an update or a device replacement (authorized change) or a different device that took the address.
en.Una red de control no deberia necesitar: A control network should not need Internet names; they indicate Internet access, automatic updates or third-party software that communicates outward.
en.Una regla que permite cualquier origen h: A rule that allows any source to any destination defeats the segmentation the firewall is meant to enforce between zones.
en.Una regla sin aciertos puede ser de uso: A rule without hits can be of seasonal use (maintenance, start-up, annual backup): deleting it can cut an infrequent operation.
en.Una regla sin trafico en la ventana de c: A rule with no traffic in the capture window is not necessarily unnecessary: it may cover infrequent operations. Traffic with no rule, or denied traffic that was observed, indicates a missing rule, a control not applied or a capture point different from the firewall.
en.Una retransmision vista en un espejo pue: A retransmission seen on a mirror can be a capture artifact: do not conclude from a single measurement.
en.Una ruta estatica aparentemente sin uso: A seemingly unused static route can be a backup for a future failure: removing it can cut communication when the main link fails.
en.Una ruta estatica hacia un salto que no: A static route to a next hop that does not respond, or that no observed traffic uses, is legacy configuration that widens the attack surface and can divert or drop traffic.
en.Una tormenta de difusion o multidifusion: A broadcast or multicast storm reaches every device in the layer 2 domain, consumes controller CPU and can leave control traffic unanswered. It usually comes from a layer 2 loop, a faulty card or a misconfigured device; it can also be a legitimate industrial multicast protocol (GOOSE, PROFINET), which must be ruled out first.
en.Una vulnerabilidad abierta en un activo: An open vulnerability on an asset that communicates on the control network is a path to compromise; the priority depends on its exposure and on the conduits that reach it.
en.Usar RDP con autenticacion a nivel de re: Use RDP with network level authentication or, better, a jump server.
en.Usar SSH version 2 y un tiempo de inacti: Use SSH version 2 and an idle timeout on the lines (verify the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Usar autenticacion MD5 (o cadena de clav: Use MD5 authentication (or key chain) on HSRP/VRRP where the version allows it, filter these protocols on edge ports and limit with ACLs who can advertise them.
en.Usar direccionamiento estatico o reserva: Use static addressing or MAC reservations for control devices.
en.Usar el analisis de reglas y el contador: Use the rule analysis and the hit counter of the access control policy (Policies > Access Control) to identify unused or shadowed rules (check the syntax in the vendor documentation for the installed version).
en.Usar el contador de aciertos y los event: Use the hit counter and the connection events to see what traffic uses it.
en.Usar enable secret y secretos tipo 8 o 9: Use enable secret and type 8 or 9 secrets for local users, rotate the exposed credentials and control where configuration backups are stored.
en.Usar la lista de vulnerabilidades del ac: Use the asset's vulnerability list and its risk score to order the work.
en.Usar las comunicaciones del activo para: Use the asset's communications to confirm the real origin of the access before cutting it.
en.Usar un servidor de actualizaciones inte: Use an internal update server and approve only what the SCADA vendor has validated.
en.Usar una fuente de hora interna de la re: Use an internal time source of the OT network and, if there are several, at least two servers.
en.Uso de USB y otros medios removibles con: Use of USB and other removable media controlled (ports blocked or prior check on a dedicated workstation) and no personal devices connected.
en.Usuarios, contrasenas, comunidades SNMP: Users, passwords, SNMP communities and factory keys changed or disabled.
en.VLAN 1 en uso o como VLAN nativa (segun: VLAN 1 in use or as native VLAN (per the switch configuration)
en.VLAN con equipos que el SPAN no espeja (: VLAN with devices that SPAN does not mirror (per the switch configuration)
en.VLAN con equipos y sin espejo SPAN: {lis: VLANs with devices and no SPAN mirror: {lista}.
en.Validar cada dominio con su dueno, permi: Validate each domain with its owner, allow only the necessary ones through an allow list in the DNS or proxy, and block the rest.
en.Validar con el dueno del proceso cuales: Validate with the process owner which are needed, and for which devices, and note the exception with a review date.
Validate with the process owner which come from authorized systems (SCADA, HMI, engineering station) and at what times.
en.Validar con el proveedor del software cu: Validate any update with the software vendor before applying it.
en.Validar la lista con el dueno del proces: Validate the list with the process owner and set aside what nobody recognizes, without blocking it yet.
en.Validar la lista de origenes autorizados: Validate the list of sources authorized to write and restrict writing through the OT firewall or the controller configuration.
en.Varias subredes en el mismo segmento L2: Several subnets in the same L2 segment indicate incomplete segmentation: logical isolation is not backed by network isolation.
en.Varios de estos controles apagan o bloqu: Several of these controls shut down or block ports: BPDU guard puts the port that receives a BPDU into err-disable, port-security blocks a replaced device, and ARP inspection drops devices with a fixed IP that are not in an ARP ACL; a badly calibrated control can isolate a PLC or an HMI.
en.Ventana corta (menos de {c} dias): lo se: Short window (fewer than {c} days): weekly activity may not have appeared.
en.Verificar con el fabricante la version d: Verify with the vendor the recommended firmware version and the update procedure.
en.Verificar con una consulta de prueba des: Verify with a test query from the device before and after the change.
en.Verificar con una prueba de conexion des: Verify with a connection test from a representative client before removing the old one.
en.Verificar el tamano y la integridad del: Check the file size and integrity and whether it was copied completely from the capture device, and keep the log.
en.Verificar la disponibilidad del intermed: Verify the availability of the intermediary and its behavior in a failure.
en.Verificar los activos con OPC UA y la po: Check the assets with OPC UA and the observed policy to confirm that they have migrated.
en.Verificar que cada cliente soporta una p: Check that each client supports a policy with signing or encryption (for example, Basic256Sha256 or higher) with its current version.
en.Verificar que el SPAN tenga como fuente: Verify that the SPAN sources the ports or the full VLAN of the devices of interest, not just one access port, and that it is configured in both directions.
en.Verificar que el otro extremo de cada tr: Verify that the other end of each trunk will have the same native VLAN and that the new VLANs are allowed along the whole path.
en.Verificar que el switch alcanza al servi: Verify that the switch reaches the NTP server: route, firewall and management VLAN.
en.Verificar que el switch tiene imagen con: Verify that the switch has an image with cryptography, a domain name and RSA keys for SSH.
en.Verificar que la duracion cubra un ciclo: Check that the duration covers a complete operation cycle, including startups, shift changes and periodic maintenance.
en.Verificar que no haya trafico en el peri: Verify that there is no traffic in the observed period and extend the period if the route is a backup or of occasional use.
en.Verificar si cada equipo soporta el equi: Check whether each device supports the encrypted equivalent (SSH, HTTPS, SNMPv3, SFTP) with its current firmware.
en.Verificar si son equipos de planta o tra: Verify whether these are plant devices or poorly segmented transit traffic; block direct Internet egress from levels 0-2.
en.Verificar, en laboratorio o en la ventan: Verify, in a lab or in the window, that the firewall no longer accepts new connections initiated from the return direction.
en.Version de firmware expuesta en protocol: Firmware version exposed in discovery protocols
en.Version de firmware identificada y con s: Firmware version identified and supported by the manufacturer; security bulletins reviewed and patch exceptions with justification, compensating control and review date.
en.Vigilar la ocupacion del puerto destino: Watch the destination port utilization and the CPU load after the change.
en.Vigilar o bloquear servidores de mando y: Monitor or block command-and-control servers and anonymizers
en.Vigilar que no aparezcan las subfuncione: Watch for the communications restart or listen-only mode subfunctions, which have a greater impact.
en.Volver a anadir la ruta con los datos do: Add the route back with the data documented before the change.
en.Volver a capturar o importar y confirmar: Capture or import again and confirm that the unencrypted protocol no longer appears, or only in the documented exceptions.
en.Volver a conectar el equipo o su puerto: Reconnect the device or its port if the isolation cuts a legitimate function, and record the reason.
en.Volver a correr el analisis con el inven: Run the analysis again with the corrected inventory and the updated advisories and confirm the status of each row.
en.Volver a correr el analisis y confirmar: Run the analysis again and confirm that the confirmed rows show as patched or mitigated in the review columns.
en.Volver a habilitar la politica None temp: Re-enable the None policy temporarily, restricted by source, if a client loses its connection.
en.Volver a habilitar temporalmente la vers: Temporarily re-enable the previous version, limited by source, if a critical client loses its connection.
en.Volver a habilitar transport input para: Re-enable transport input for telnet only temporarily, within the window, if an operations tool depended on it.
en.Volver a la captura anterior si la nueva: Return to the previous capture if the new one could not be completed, noting its limitation in the report.
en.Volver a la lista de metodos solo local: Go back to the local-only method list within the window if the server does not respond, using the console.
en.Volver a la prioridad anterior (no spann: Go back to the previous priority (no spanning-tree vlan N priority) and remove root guard if it isolates a segment.
en.Volver a la velocidad, agregacion o poli: Go back to the previous speed, aggregation or queuing policy if the change degrades the link.
en.Volver a leer el estado con la herramien: Read the state again with the tool and confirm that the number of topology changes no longer grows and that the log shows no new MAC flapping.
en.Volver a leer la configuracion con la he: Read the configuration again with the tool and confirm that the finding no longer appears.
Read the configuration again with the tool and confirm that aaa new-model and AAA servers are declared.
Read the configuration again with the tool and confirm that the controls appear on the expected ports and VLANs.
Read the configuration again with the tool and confirm that the ports are now shut down.
Read the configuration again with the tool and confirm that no trunks without nonegotiate or ports in dynamic mode remain.
Read the configuration again with the tool and confirm that there are no longer devices in VLAN 1 or trunks with native VLAN 1.
Read the configuration again with the tool and confirm that type 0 and type 7 credentials and the enable password are no longer counted.
en.Volver a leer la configuracion del switc: Read the switch configuration again with the tool and confirm that the VLAN is no longer flagged as not mirrored.
en.Volver a leer los contadores del puerto: Read the counters of the destination port again and confirm the discards no longer grow.
en.Volver a leer los contadores y confirmar: Read the counters again and confirm that drops no longer grow and peak utilization stays under the threshold.
en.Volver a leer show logging con la herram: Read show logging again with the tool and confirm the finding disappears.
en.Volver a leer show spanning-tree detail: Read show spanning-tree detail again with the tool and confirm the root is the intended switch and its priority is no longer the factory one.
Read show spanning-tree detail again with the tool and confirm there are no ports in backup role or blocked ports receiving BPDUs from the switch itself.
en.Volver a permitir el conducto si el bloq: Allow the conduit again if the block cuts a legitimate operation, and record the reason.
en.Volver a permitir la transferencia al se: Allow the transfer again to the legitimate secondary server if replication stopped.
en.Volver al equipo anterior si el reemplaz: Go back to the previous device if the replacement affects control, following the client's change procedure.
en.Volver al respaldo del sistema anterior: Return to the backup of the previous system if an update affects control, in the maintenance window.
en.Volver al servidor NTP anterior si el nu: Go back to the previous NTP server if the new one does not respond, so the clock is not left to drift.
en.Volver al tiempo de sondeo o a la config: Return to the previous polling time or device configuration if the change degrades the conduit.
en.Volver en todos los miembros a la autent: Go back to the previous authentication on all members in the same window, so that the groups do not split.
en.Volver la regla a su accion anterior en: Return the rule to its previous action in the maintenance window if latency or false positives affect the process.
